name: A Corner, Kept Open
thesis: A midnight-purple editorial front page pairs an enormous lavender name and real Monstrosity render with a personal welcome letter. The reading path moves from physical machines to software, then opens onto a warmer purple chapter about shared workshops and community.
interaction: Native disclosures open individual SERV0, DAVID, and Monstrosity project stories, plus field notes on software, makerspace responsibility, and Outpost. In-page navigation and project, GitHub, email, and résumé links work without JavaScript.
why: Extends My Little Corner’s personal purple palette and the intimate letter with oversized typography and authentic machine imagery. The full portrait includes Svelte and TypeScript, Stardance pull requests, One Stone safety and tooling instruction, VEX shop leadership, and hands-on support for Outpost makers.
